intent: Sync Drive and AppFlowy into a local Markdown store for LightRAG, answer with cited links via a local filter and Claude, and bridge topics to NotebookLM with reviewed pruning

decisions.decision: Keep the pinned store path data/inputs/<source>/<source_id>.md and stage a flat copy <source>__<source_id>.md into data/inputs/ for POST /documents/scan
decisions.why: v1.5.6 scan uses one os.scandir of INPUT_DIR and skips subdirectories; file_path is stored as basename, so the flat name keys back to the record
decisions.rejected: Moving the store outside data/inputs or using /documents/upload, which contradict pinned identifiers

decisions.decision: Remove via DELETE /documents/delete_document {doc_ids, delete_file:true}, polling pipeline_status to idle; never call bare DELETE /documents
decisions.why: The spec's DELETE /documents/{doc_id} does not exist in v1.5.6; bare DELETE /documents clears the whole KB

decisions.decision: kb.sh orchestrates plan -> backup.sh on host -> apply; kb-sync refuses removals without a backup newer than the plan
decisions.why: The container has no Docker socket and must not mount data/backups (Invariant 4); this guarantees SC-008

decisions.decision: Retrieve with POST /query only_need_context and parse the Document Chunks JSON block; send only chunks to Claude
decisions.why: Matches the pinned call; chunks carry reference_id -> file_path for citations; entities/relations lack per-source refs
decisions.rejected: POST /query/data (structured, but not the pinned identifier)

decisions.decision: Reranker = llama.cpp server --reranking with bge-reranker-v2-m3 GGUF on CPU, wired via LightRAG RERANK_BINDING=cohere; kb-sync probes it and falls back to Ollama 0-3 scoring
decisions.why: Small CPU image speaking the Cohere/Jina rerank shape; LightRAG applies MIN_RERANK_SCORE itself

decisions.decision: MCP server runs over stdio via scripts/kb.sh mcp -> compose run --rm -T kb-sync mcp
decisions.why: Keeps it containerised (Principle II) with no daemon

decisions.decision: Records in one SQLite file data/kb-sync/kb-sync.db with per-item transactions and JSON run logs; data/kb-sync joins backup.sh/restore.sh
Nightly via systemd user timer calling kb.sh nightly, pull+ingest only, SuccessExitStatus=4 for held removals
decisions.why: Matches ollama.service pattern; keeps outbound content owner-initiated (Principle III)
decisions.rejected: cron; including NotebookLM/Claude in the nightly job

plan.summary: Plan, research (R1-R13), data model and four contracts for kb-sync
plan.key_finding: LightRAG v1.5.6 scan is non-recursive and has no DELETE /documents/{doc_id}; the spec's pinned store path and removal route need the staging and delete_document corrections

tasks.summary: 97 tasks in 10 phases (Setup, Foundational, US1-US7, Polish), each laid out as waves; every file has one owner phase

approach: A Python kb-sync one-shot Compose service under sync/, wrapped by scripts/kb.sh, keeps a SQLite record per item and drives LightRAG only over REST: stage flat copies and scan, delete via delete_document after a host-side backup. ask/kb_search retrieve context-only, filter via LightRAG's rerank binding to a loopback llama.cpp reranker (Ollama scoring fallback), and send only surviving chunks to Claude.
